terms_summary.commission: Up to 22% commission on every paying customer referred, for 12 months from qualifying subscriptions

result.blocker: Unlike other PartnerStack-hosted programs seen this session (which used a shared PartnerStack application form), ElevenLabs' affiliate signup is gated behind creating a full ElevenLabs PRODUCT account first (https://elevenlabs.io/app/sign-up, requires email + password), not just a lightweight PartnerStack application. Filled the email field (support@coshuma.com) and checked the required Terms/Privacy agreement checkbox, then left the password field empty per standing instruction to only leave password entry to 큰형. Did not click the final 'Sign up' button.
result.notes: 큰형 needs to: 1) go to https://elevenlabs.io/app/sign-up?redirect=%2Fapp%2Fhome%3Faffiliate%3Dtrue (may need to re-enter email if session was lost), 2) set a password and complete account creation (may include email verification), 3) once logged in, the affiliate enrollment should appear automatically via the ?affiliate=true redirect, or can be found in account settings. After that, the tracking link becomes available through PartnerStack (dash.partnerstack.com/elevenlabsinc).
